question.problem:
Find the coordinates of the vector $x$ relative to the basis $B=\{{b}_{1},{b}_{2},{b}_{3}\},$ where

$$
{b}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ -2 \\ 1\end{aligned}],\,{b}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 2 \\ 3\end{aligned}],\,{b}_{3}=[\begin{aligned}4 \\ 3 \\ -1\end{aligned}],\,x=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ -5 \\ 10\end{aligned}].
$$

If $[x]_{B}=[\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{2} \\ {x}_{3}\end{aligned}]$ then what is the value of ${x}_{1}+{x}_{2}+{x}_{3}?$
question.worked_solution:
We need to find ${x}_{1}$,  ${x}_{2}$, and ${x}_{3}$ such that 

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}{b}_{1}+{x}_{2}{b}_{2}+{x}_{3}{b}_{3} & =x \\ {x}_{1}[\begin{aligned}2 \\ -2 \\ 1\end{aligned}]+{x}_{2}[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 2 \\ 3\end{aligned}]+{x}_{3}[\begin{aligned}4 \\ 3 \\ -1\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}2 \\ -5 \\ 10\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

From this, we get the system with the augmented matrix $M$, which we reduce using Gaussian elimination:

$$
\begin{aligned}M= & [\begin{aligned}2 & 0 & 4 & 2 \\ -2 & 2 & 3 & -5 \\ 1 & 3 & -1 & 10\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+{R}_{1} \\ ∼ & [\begin{aligned}2 & 0 & 4 & 2 \\ 0 & 2 & 7 & -3 \\ 1 & 3 & -1 & 10\end{aligned}] & {R}_{1} & ↔{R}_{3} \\ ∼ & [\begin{aligned}1 & 3 & -1 & 10 \\ 0 & 2 & 7 & -3 \\ 2 & 0 & 4 & 2\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+(-2){R}_{1} \\ ∼ & [\begin{aligned}1 & 3 & -1 & 10 \\ 0 & 2 & 7 & -3 \\ 0 & -6 & 6 & -18\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+3{R}_{2} \\ ∼ & [\begin{aligned}1 & 3 & -1 & 10 \\ 0 & 2 & 7 & -3 \\ 0 & 0 & 27 & -27\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

The system is now 

$$
\{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}+3{x}_{2}-{x}_{3}=10 \\ 2{x}_{2}+7{x}_{3}=-3 \\ 27{x}_{3}=-27.\end{aligned}
$$

From the  third equation, we get ${x}_{3}=-1.$  Substituting this value into the second equation yields

$$
2{x}_{2}+7(-1)=-3\,⟹\,{x}_{2}=2.
$$

Finally, by substituting ${x}_{2}=2$ and ${x}_{3}=-1$ into the first equation we obtain

$$
{x}_{1}+3(2)-(-1)=10\,⟹\,{x}_{1}=3.
$$

Therefore, $[x]_{B}=[\begin{aligned}3 \\ 2 \\ -1\end{aligned}].$ 

Finally, 

$$
{x}_{1}+{x}_{2}+{x}_{3}=3+2+(-1)=4.
$$
